title: CONSIDER: A. APPROVE an increase in Life-of-Project (LOP) budget for the Los Angeles Union Station West ADA Improvements Project #210191 (Project) by a…
text:
[Metro Board file 2026-0660, Project]
[FINANCE, BUDGET, AND AUDIT COMMITTEE MADE THE FOLLOWING RECOMMENDATION (3-0):]
CONSIDER:

A.	APPROVE an increase in Life-of-Project (LOP) budget for the Los Angeles Union Station West ADA Improvements Project #210191 (Project) by a total of $4,350,000, from $10,500,000 to $14,850,000; and

B.	AMEND the FY27 budget to increase funding for Project #210191 by $3,500,000 from $3,500,000 to $7,000,000.
